divincenzo_scorecard.title: DiVincenzo Criteria Quantum Hardware Compliance Scorecard

criteria.criterion: Scalable physical system with well-characterized qubits
criteria.assessment: Statevector Hilbert space representation natively supports N-qubit tensor product structures.

criteria.criterion: Ability to initialize state of qubits to simple fiducial state (|00...0>)
criteria.assessment: Exact ground state initialization verified with 100% fidelity.

criteria.criterion: Long relevant decoherence times (T1, T2 >> gate time)
criteria.assessment: T1 (50us) and T2 (70us) parameter tracking modeled against typical 100ns gate durations.

criteria.criterion: Universal set of quantum gates (H, Phase, CNOT / Clifford + T)
criteria.assessment: Universal gate set (H, S, T, Pauli, Rotations, CNOT, CZ) fully implemented.

criteria.criterion: Qubit-specific measurement capability with high readout fidelity
criteria.assessment: Projective measurement sampling with readout confusion matrix calibration.

criteria.criterion: Interconvert stationary and flying qubits (Quantum Communication)
criteria.assessment: Simulated photon state transfer channels supported via interface abstractions.

criteria.criterion: Faithfully transmit flying qubits between specified locations
criteria.assessment: Fidelity preservation modeled over fiber loss attenuation equations.
